about_short_description.short_description: Roboflow is a developer tool for building computer vision models faster and more accurately.

product.name: Roboflow Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for building, training, and deploying computer vision models with integrated tools for dataset management, annotation, training, and deployment.

product.name: Roboflow Inference
product.description: An open source, production-ready inference server for running computer vision models on-device or in the cloud with support for multiple architectures.

product.name: Roboflow Annotate
product.description: A suite of AI-assisted annotation tools for labeling and managing image and video datasets, supporting collaborative workflows and automation.

product.name: Roboflow Train
product.description: A hosted model training infrastructure with API endpoints, offering multiple model sizes for balancing accuracy and compute requirements.

product.name: Roboflow Deploy
product.description: A managed deployment service for running vision AI models at scale via hosted APIs or edge devices with monitoring and scaling capabilities.

product.name: Roboflow Workflows
product.description: An integrated visual workflow builder to create, test, and deploy complex vision AI pipelines combining models, APIs, and external applications.
